svg.title: Engineering Activity Portfolio architecture
svg.desc: On this machine, an hourly collector reads local hooks and logs from Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor plus the public GitHub contribution calendar, and reduces them to dates and counts. Prompts, code, filenames, and repository names never leave the machine. The validated snapshot is published to a public activity feed in the repository. GitHub Actions runs the tests and privacy check, builds the static export, and deploys it to GitHub Pages. Visitors' browsers load the static site and poll the feed for a newer day. The contact form and blog editor go through a Cloudflare Worker.
